critical_errors: mistakenly naming a different type of quadrilateral like trapezoid or kite
stating that it is not related to any parallelogram types
misconceptions: claiming all shapes are different from each other
stating that only one shape is correct without considering others
mixing up properties of parallelograms with other quadrilaterals
grading_notes: Ensure the answer includes at least a parallelogram and considers multiple types. Credit for including rectangle, rhombus, or square as additional options.
